title: Gibson Original Hardshell Case, Thunderbird, Brown

long_description.body:
Gibson Original Series hardshell cases are designed to protect your Gibson instrument in style. Featuring the highest quality materials and hardware, they meet Gibson's stringent factory specifications and are available in a variety of sizes so they'll fit your cherished Gibson like a glove.




3 heavy duty latches
Accessory compartment
Red plush interior lining
Internal dimensions: 52.00” length, 16.19” upper body width, 16.19” lower body width, 4.13” depth.
